question: The boiling point of liquid nitrogen is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**-196 oC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The boiling point of liquid nitrogen is **-196 oC**.
 
• Liquid nitrogen is a cryogenic fluid that can cause rapid freezing on contact with living tissue.
 
• It is commonly used in various industrial and medical applications, including cryopreservation and cryotherapy.
 
• Due to its extremely low boiling point, it must be stored in specialized insulated containers to prevent rapid evaporation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Liquid nitrogen** is produced industrially in large quantities by fractional distillation of liquid air.
 
• It is colorless, odorless, and extremely cold.
 
• Handling liquid nitrogen requires proper safety precautions to avoid frostbite and other injuries.
 
• It is also used in the food industry for flash freezing and in scientific research for creating extremely low-temperature environments.
